{{recipe}}

'''''Tapenade''''' is a traditional provencale paste of olives, anchovies and capers. Although some versions exclude the capers, the word ''tapenade'' has its origins in the provencale ''tapena'' (caper).

== Ingredients ==
*6 cured [[Cookbook:Anchovy|anchovies]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Caper|capers]], rinsed and drained
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) pitted black [[Cookbook:Olive|olives]]
*Extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]

== Procedure ==

# Blend the anchovies, capers and olives. For this a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] is better than the traditional [[Cookbook:Mortar and Pestle|mortar and pestle]].
# Mix in a few tablespoons olive oil until smooth.
# Serve on [[Cookbook:Toast|toast]] as an [[Wikipedia:Amuse-bouche|amuse-bouche]], or with boiled [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], with [[Cookbook:Feta Cheese|goat cheese]] and roasted [[Cookbook:Chili Pepper|peppers]], or on [[Cookbook:Pasta|potato gnocchi]].
